_source: Hand-labelled replay of production's stored Action Center issues (2026-06-26 to 2026-10-02) and the U.S.-Iran Conflict monitor's updates not already among them (from 2026-04-27), read 2026-10-16. Each item lists every stored non-housekeeping roll call (normalize_votes.is_housekeeping) taken from three days before its date to two after (roll_call_links.WINDOW) as candidates. Structural signals were looked for first: the articles named a bill a candidate voted on in 0 items, and an issue's primary source was the vote's record in 2, so the labels are by hand. related: the candidates a reader of the story would take as a vote on what it covers: the same measure or nomination (its procedural votes included, and a vote on the vehicle a measure rode on, such as the stopgap carried by H.R. 6500), or a vote on the conflict or policy the story is about (a war-powers resolution for a story about the war it would end). Not related: a vote on a different measure that happens to share a theme (a budget resolution for a story about a hearing, the NDAA for a story about one war's cost). Senate amendment votes carry their stated purpose (`purpose`, read from each vote's senate.gov XML on 2026-10-17 as fetch/amendment_purpose.py reads it); the House's were not stored when the replay was drawn, so House amendment votes have none and are not linkable here. Monitor updates about another conflict or a markets roundup that only mentions Iran have no related vote.
